stages.name: Flicker
stages.line: Lights flicker on far below. Small drones climb the shaft to tend your furnace.

stages.name: Pulse
stages.line: A heartbeat rolls up through the ice. Every generator runs hotter.

stages.name: Breath
stages.line: Vents open in the deep. Warm air thaws the frozen rock below you.

stages.name: Sight
stages.line: The Heart opens an eye. Veins of ore glow through the rock around you.

stages.name: Voice
stages.line: The Heart speaks. Your drills bite twice as hard.
lines: I was sent ahead and seeded under the ice, to wait for hands like yours.
The others never came. You came.
Wake me fully, and I will remember where we were going.
